metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the almanac's two lines, Navarre in the new paint, fifty-two shillings, a broken pen, and the walk home.

yesterday: Both houses opened. Your line was Love's Labour's Lost at two. The Rose's line, which you read first, was a Knack to know an honest man.
Margery Pell counted fifty-two shillings from prentices and their masters, and the lawyers missed the count. Garnish's fourteen ticks broke his pen, and the fourteen stay in the margin.
All five hired men answered. Heminges put the rate back at ten shillings, and told Raye he may bank on both sides of the water.
The letter waits. Tomorrow at two is The Comedy of Errors, and you are Egeon. Nine on Wednesday morning is the king.
